Reaction of businesses in the both parts of the Atlantics to the EU-US trade agreement was underwhelming - very weak positive in the US and quite strong negative in the EU stock market movement, critisizm of the deal in Germany and Franz, Sholz said it is going to have a negative effect 

There was no formally signed text presented, only verbal explnation. It followed with comments from both sides:
